# firewall-rules

Firewall rules decide which traffic is allowed to reach instances in a VPC.

Operation `firewall_rule_list`.

`GET /v1/firewall-rules?vpc=<uuid>`.

|---|---|---|---|---|

| `tenant` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single tenant. |
| `vpc` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to firewall rules attached to this VPC. Required. |

## PATCH /v1/firewall-rules/{firewall_rule_id}

Operation `firewall_rule_update`.

Change a firewall rule in place. Fields left out keep their value; the cidr, port, and ICMP fields clear when sent as `null`. Tenant-member gated; the rule's VPC is re-realised.
